lines.text: Hi! I'm Bolu, the little helper inside AwaazForm.
Forms are everywhere. But tiny boxes, confusing words and lots of typing make them hard for many people, especially if you can't see well, can't type easily, or prefer Hindi.
AwaazForm lets you fill forms, just by talking. Your voice. Your form. Your access.
Every answer goes through the Confidence Loop. I listen, I write down what you said, I check it, and I read it back to you. Nothing is filled until you say yes.
Let's try it. What is your date of birth?
I understand that as the twelfth of March, nineteen seventy eight, and ask: is this right? When you confirm, watch me type it in. Then I double check that it really landed.
Every step I take shows up in the activity list, in plain words. No hidden actions, ever.
Got a printed PDF, like this voter registration form? Upload it. It never leaves your browser. I find the questions, you nudge the boxes into place, and I fill it in. I even tick the right box.
Want to go hands free? Turn on Live Mode and simply talk. Say yes to confirm, next to move on, or interrupt me any time.
Your saved details stay on your device, locked with a passphrase if you like. I never fill passwords or payments, and I never press submit. That choice is always yours.
Big buttons, high contrast, large text, Hindi, and full keyboard control. Built for everyone.
AwaazForm. Your voice. Your form. Your access. Bye bye!
